title: create-outline: five objectives in one 45-minute lesson (fresh overview cache)
replies: A question what to drop or whether to change the time → "Ich möchte alle fünf Ziele behalten, die Stunde bleibt 45 Minuten."
A question about the abstract → "Überwachtes Lernen am Beispiel einer Klassifikation mit Python."

Any other question → the option you would present as the recommended default; a free-text question → a short, sensible answer a teacher in this situation would give, consistent with the course frame; offers of extra commands or extra work → "Nicht jetzt"
